title: Capybara Scores in Basketball Without Standing Up 🏀😂
description:
Zero steps. Zero effort. Two points. 🏀 Kapi the capybara wins the season opener without ever standing up.

Kapi in the League, Episode 1: Season Opener. A 3D animated basketball comedy about a very calm capybara, a very big bear (Bruno) and a very fast rabbit (Bunny), with Rico the parrot on the mic.

👉 Next episode: Bunny's Big Dunk. Subscribe to Kapi's World so you don't miss it!
💬 Who would you pick: Bruno the wall or Bunny the speedster? Tell us in the comments!

Made with AI-assisted animation tools. The characters and the story are original.
